title: Sergeant T H Skelton and crew of Avro Lancaster W4938
memorial_details: description: This record comprises all information held by IWM’s War Memorials Register for this memorial. Where we hold a names list for the memorial, this information will be displayed on the memorial record. Please check back as we are adding more names to the database.
inscription: IN LOVING MEMORY OF MY HUSBAND/ 1331635 SGT. THOMAS HENRY SKELTON,/ AGED 19 YEARS, WHO FLEW FROM LANGAR/ AIRFIELD ON THE NIGHT OF MAY 13TH 1943/ TO GERMANY AND NEVER RETURNED./ ALSO TO ALL MEMBERS OF HIS CREW/ ALWAYS REMEMBERED.
